{{Quote|I don't know you. I don't want to. Explain yourselves.|Hoogi Grym, to the agents sent by Evin Telbre|<ref name="Beneath Aucellis Park">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030821aucellis|text=Beneath Aucellis Park|int=Beneath Aucellis Park}}</ref>}}
'''Hoogi Grym''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], working as the head of security at the entertainment park [[Aucellis Park]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Keriba VI]]. Aucellis Park was secretly an Imperial re-education facility that used the drug [[Platykona-zemlo-mobris|pleaz-mo]] to influence the minds of visitors and after a shipment of the drugs went missing while en-route to Aucellis Park, Grym hired the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Balthazar Sim]] to cover up all evidence of the missing drugs, to prevent them from being linked with Aucellis Park and causing the Imperial re-education center to be exposed. Sim carried out the assignment and traveled to the park, to meet with Grym. However, [[Evin Telbre]], a businessman who had a score to settle with Sim, tracked the smuggler to Aucellis Park and dispatched a team of agents to track Sim down. The agents confronted Grym and Sim inside the park's re-education center and subsequently engaged the pair in combat.
